However, the act itself supports the tobacco industry, which has a lot of negative impacts on public health. So, putting it all together, while asking for a cigarette might not be inherently wrong in a legal sense, it goes against health recommendations and societal efforts to reduce smoking. It's probably better to avoid it to support public health initiatives and set a positive example.
